svg.title: End-to-End OEM/ODM Digital & Quality Control Infrastructure
svg.desc: APTREDLIGHT buyer-facing project workflow illustration, prepared as a marketing draft. Publish only checked process descriptions. This file does not assert universal certification, existing overseas warehouses or customer outcomes, and its public-oriented filename is not a deployment confirmation.
